claims.statement: The ingest pipeline runs on the ingest RQ queue (single worker-ingest replica) and exposes two entry points on KnowledgeIngestionUseCases — ingest_document (parse → canonicalize → digest (LLM) → embed → write) and ingest_version — built by app/composition/project_knowledge.build_knowledge_ingestion_use_cases(db) and sharing the cached LLM clients from graph.factories._build_cached_clients.

Ingest tunables live as code constants in backend/app/core/config.py: DIGEST_SECTION_CHARS=6000, DIGEST_SECTION_OVERLAP=400, DIGEST_MAX_SECTIONS=20, INGEST_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600; INGEST_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is deliberately not env-tunable because it bounds the worst-case cost of a malicious or runaway doc.

The version ingest path uses a deterministic job_id=f"knowledge-version-{version_id}" so re-enqueue is a no-op and an in-flight version can be introspected; enqueue_ingest_version raises RuntimeError("knowledge version enqueue failed") when the enqueue returns None so the admin UI surfaces the failure.

The category worker shares the ingest queue (deterministic job_id=f"category-revision-{revision_id}"), uses build_category_use_cases + build_knowledge_provider_factory, and re-raises failures as CategoryActivationError("category_worker_failed") so the admin UI gets a typed signal.

RQ-level failures (notably JobTimeoutException from the death penalty) are caught in the sync wrapper and recorded via _mark_doc_failed_sync / _mark_version_failed_sync, which open a sync SQLAlchemy session and call mark_document_failed_sync / mark_version_failed_sync in the repository so the terminal state is durable even when the async path is dead.

Migration 0050 (data_ingestion_recovery) introduced the recovery bookkeeping: kb_versions rows carry a processing token that the worker claims atomically; a stuck INGESTING row beyond INGEST_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is safe to retry because the same deterministic job_id makes re-enqueue a no-op and stale chunks can be cleaned before the retry runs.

The category worker generates a processing_token up-front and only writes results whose token matches the current claim, so a late-finishing previous attempt cannot overwrite the next attempt's activation.

The ingestion state machine (RECEIVED → STORED → PARSED → NORMALIZED → CLASSIFIED → EXTRACTED → VALIDATED → REVIEW_REQUIRED → APPROVED → PUBLISHED → INDEXED, plus FAILED_TRANSIENT/FAILED_PERMANENT/QUARANTINED/SUPERSEDED) is enforced by ALLOWED_STATE_TRANSITIONS in backend/app/project_knowledge/domain/ingestion.py.
